title: Own-business server builds retain progress and explicitly retry the same failed action
steps: Run the actual FromBusiness component in Chromium through building, failure, reopening, explicit Retry and completion; repeat with a blocked immutable brief.
expect: A server-owned action shows building and elapsed minutes without opening a chat.
Failure and remount retain the same business; Retry sends the same failed action ID without research or template selection.
The site opens and the kept business clears only after completion, with no chat preparation.
A blocked immutable brief preserves the business and exposes no futile retry.
fence: The real Add site component observes terminal server-owned actions and keeps recovery authority across remounts.

tests: a server-owned build shows building, survives reopening and retries the same site before opening
a blocked immutable brief has no futile own-site retry button
